title: Check the season for a month
description:
Write a function called check_season, it takes a month parameter and returns the season: Autumn, Winter, Spring or Summer.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as check_season(month), where month is the English month name (e.g. 'January', case-insensitive), returning one of the strings 'Autumn', 'Winter', 'Spring' or 'Summer' using the meteorological northern-hemisphere seasons (Sep-Nov Autumn, Dec-Feb Winter, Mar-May Spring, Jun-Aug Summer).
hints: Normalize the input with .lower() (or .capitalize()) so the check is case-insensitive.
Group the twelve month names into four lists or a dict mapping month to season.
September, October, November are Autumn; December, January, February are Winter; March, April, May are Spring; June, July, August are Summer.
expected_behavior: Returns 'Autumn', 'Winter', 'Spring' or 'Summer' depending on which group the given month name falls into.
explanation: The twelve month names are grouped into the four meteorological seasons; the function normalizes the input's case and looks up which group it belongs to.
